The existence of sites like Mallia, Gournia,and Zakros has led historians to divide their history into four "palatial" periods. A massivevolcanic eruption on Thera has been postulated as the cause of this civilization's decline in the 15thcentury BCE, when they were occupied by Myceneans and maintained only Knossos.
